title: Cutting-Edge tools to build subscriptions
body: Our platform combines cutting-edge AI models with intuitive interfaces to streamline your development workflow and boost productivity.

card1.title: Team collaboration
card1.body: Discuss in context, mention teammates, and resolve threads without leaving the flow of work.

card2.title: Collaborative Analysis
card2.body: Turn scattered signals into shared understanding with live insights your whole team can explore.

card3.title: Workflow Automation
card3.body: Trigger agents from events, chain tools with conditions.

card4.title: Omnichannel Messaging
card4.body: Send campaigns across email, chat, and more—every reply lands in one unified inbox.

card5.title: Build in the cloud
card5.body: Plan launches, manage approvals, and keep assets aligned—from brief to rollout.
